guidetextdraw_1031073523._value:
Eligibility Requirements

  • Graduate from a California high school (unless due to military orders that required you or your parent or guardian be out of state at the time of your graduation) or have completed a high school graduation equivalency (including GED or the California High School Proficiency Exam) on or after June 30, 2000.
  • Be a California resident at the time of your high school graduation, or its equivalent
  • Earn a verified cumulative Community College GPA of at least 2.4
  • Attended and completed at least one term at a CA Community College and be transferring or transferred to a CA baccalaureate degree granting institution
  • Be no more than 27 years of age by December 31 in the year of first award
guidetextdraw_1031073523.name: textdraw1653986705204

guidetextdraw._value: INSTRUCTIONS: Submit this completed form and all required documents indicated in Section A or Section B to the Office of Financial Aid. Failure to submit this form could adversely affect your ability to be considered for a Cal Grant Award.
